metadata_only_finalization: completed_room_sha256 (only before an explicit reviewed resume)

protocol.inputs: Verify every frozen source, original run-result byte pin and every retained artifact hash. Close complete run-root, case-root and project-root file sets, with only the separately pinned run_result itself outside its own artifact map. Linked or nonregular inputs and unpinned additions are refused before and after analysis.
protocol.ordering: Case IDs sorted exactly as the existing CLI filesystem order; completion arrival order cannot change terminal order.
protocol.output: Write each room only once; retain all malformed/faulty/unavailable results exactly from frozen safe_analyze_run. No model calls, no evaluator code or ground-truth changes.
protocol.resume: Any interruption preserves all raw files. A subsequent separately frozen execution/resume plan must pin the exact complete existing room-file set and unchanged source/terminal/queue/equivalence pins before scheduling only missing identities. Never overwrite, delete or rerun completed rows.
protocol.statistics: Wrapper produces immutable row artifacts and terminal provenance/counts, no new bootstrap or scientific aggregation. Existing independently frozen report code computes final statistics from retained labels; no competing resample implementation.
protocol.volatile_evidence: Only generated_at, timestamp, elapsed_seconds and duration_ms may differ in equivalence normalization; raw repeat output and exact paths/values of excluded fields are retained separately. All labels, faults, providers, actions, paths and input identities compare without normalization.

scope: All120 registered drift identities, including failed and unexecuted identities, after terminal generation. No labels or outcome selection changed.

unit_tests.interpretation: Synthetic/mock orchestration fixtures only, including full120 identity closure and119missing/1reused no-overwrite test.
